name: Synthwave Hero
description: Full-screen retro synthwave hero with an endlessly scrolling perspective neon grid, horizon glow, scanlines and a glowing center title that tilts with the mouse or device orientation.
contents: Perspective neon grid scrolling toward the viewer
Glowing center title or custom center content
behavior: Scene and title fade in over the intro duration while the perspective settles
Grid scrolls infinitely and the title hovers gently
Mouse position or device tilt rotates the scene and shifts the grid via GSAP
Reduced motion stops the grid scroll and hover
editableByProps: Title text or fully custom center content
Background, grid, horizon, scanline and text colors
Grid density, tilt, speed, spread and perspective
Intro and hover timing, tilt strength, scanline and glow toggles

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the title glow or typography
needsCodeEdit.where: textShadow style on the centerText span

fixed: Adds window mousemove and deviceorientation listeners while tilt is enabled and removes them on unmount
